name: Rune Ring
body:
RUNE RING

Aura faint transmutation; CL 1st; Slot ring; Price 200 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

Carved from tarnished bone or brass and inscribed with ancient vitality runes, a rune ring grants its wearer a +1 competence bonus to maximum Hit Points.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells virtue or false life; Cost 100 gp.
